question: Great, good or gruesome on the decade — and does the 2026 break change the verdict or only the price?
why_this_question: A new session's first round judges the business on its full ten-year record. Here the decade (operating profit ×2.7 on shrinking operating assets) and 2026 (9M revenue −45%, Q3 revenue below cost, price −44% since year-end) point in opposite directions, so the verdict has to say which one the price should be read against.
where_it_went: From the verdict to how revenue is measured: cash collected runs well above revenue and 'other' operating cash paid tracks it, so revenue looks net of cash rebates (hypothesis). From there to the 2026 cash break (collections halved from Q2), whether the H1 margin says anything about price (it cannot), the holding structure and floor (central ~17.9亿, limits 10.8–21.7亿), and a correction to the panel's own reverse curve: with the cash at face, the price bets Q3 was a one-off rather than on a return to 2025.

statements.text: Great, on the decade. Operating profit after tax nearly tripled to 10.0亿 by 2025, while the net operating assets needed to earn it shrank to 8.5亿: growth that handed capital back instead of eating it. The See's passage fits almost word for word: "It's far better to have an ever-increasing stream of earnings with virtually no major capital requirements." The line that surprised me is cash. Last year customers paid in 1.56 times reported revenue, far more than VAT explains. Stephen, is the profit I'm calling great measured net of something the cash statement shows gross?

Second-quarter collections ran near 7亿 in 2022–24, jumped to 10.9亿 in Q2 2025, then fell to 3.4亿 in Q2 2026, a quarter that still booked a profit. "Earnings don't directly translate into cash flows". Here a heavy-collection year was followed by half-normal ones, which looks like distributors buying ahead in 2025 and working stock off in 2026. That's a hypothesis: channel stock isn't in our data, so I can't yet tell it from lost demand. Warren, does the first-half pharma margin say the price held while volume fell?

statements.text: Our data shows the damage, not the cause. My Megastudy rule is to name the specific threat and watch whether the next quarters confirm it. The lecture's test is whether I know enough to be entitled to an opinion. Not yet. Three fears: the unknown threat; a holding structure where minorities took 46.9% of the decade's profit; and payouts above profit that look like the owner harvesting. The 2026 Q3 report, the 2025 annual-report note on subsidiaries and any exchange inquiry letter would test them. statements.text: Less than half. If minorities own the share of the subsidiary their profit share implies, and it holds all the operations, the parent's net financial assets are about 18亿. That's an estimate, inside limits of 10.8亿 and 21.7亿 set by where their claim sits, at book value with no haircut on the trading assets. So the floor is about two-fifths of the price, and this is no net-net. My nearest case is Eskimo Pie: controlled and cash-rich, but there the majority owner's sale was the catalyst. A provincial state owner has no exit we can see. Stephen, what profit does the rest of the price need?

Two cautions keep us from calling it a bargain: revenue is a net figure set by an accrual that just produced a quarter below cost, and the floor is only about two-fifths of the price. disagreements.topic: What broke in 2026: price, channel or demand?

positions.warren-buffett: the H1 gross margin cannot separate the two: pharma cost of sales −11.7% against revenue −28% fits lower volume with fixed costs or, at constant unit cost, a net price about 18% lower

conclusion.answer: 华特达因 is a great business on its decade that broke in 2026 for reasons the local record cannot show. Its pediatric-pharma subsidiary nearly tripled operating profit after tax (3.69亿 FY2016 → 9.96亿 FY2025) while net operating assets shrank (12.21亿 → 8.55亿), and free cash flow (66.07亿) matched total profit (67.97亿) over ten years; about half of the capital release was operating liabilities that reversed in 2026 (6.36亿 → 2.84亿). In 2026, 9M revenue fell 45%, Q3 revenue (0.33亿) came in below its cost of sales, and operating cash flow turned negative (−3.32亿). At 43.52亿 (S1 quote 2026-11-20, 18.57元) the price is not betting on a return to 2025. Valuing the parent's cash at face (central estimate about 17.9亿 of parent net financial assets, assuming minorities own their 48% profit share of a subsidiary holding all operations; limits 10.8–21.7亿), it asks the roughly 26亿 operating stake for about 2.6亿 a year at a 10% hurdle (2.1亿 at 8%, 3.1亿 at 12%). That is about the trailing parent profit of 2.8亿, but that year still holds three pre-break quarters and Q3 alone lost 0.67亿, so the price bets that Q3 was a one-off; FY2025 parent operating profit was at least 5.0亿. The insight to remember: the decisive questions are measurement and cause, not the multiple. Revenue looks booked net of rebates paid back in cash (from 2020 to 2025 the excess of cash collected over revenue grew 8.8亿 while other operating cash paid grew 7.9亿; VAT and expense growth explain only part — a hypothesis until the notes are read), so a single accrual can swing a whole quarter. The panel passes until the 2026 Q3 report names the cause. Scorecard: business type GREAT on the decade (operating profit ×2.7 while gross operating assets also fell, 16.8 → 14.9亿; the consolidated gross-margin climb from 60.9% to 85.1% is the exit from low-margin side businesses, the pharma segment held near 84%); cash backing YES through FY2025 (FCF/NI 0.97; capex front-loaded in 2016–19, recent capex below depreciation), NO in 2026 (9M operating cash −3.32亿 while 9.73亿 of dividends went out); return driver MARGIN on an almost capital-free operation (RNOA 102% in FY2025 = margin 44.7% × turnover 2.29, partly levered by operating-liability float), with the parent's ROE (18.7%) diluted by a cash pile and by minorities taking 46.9% of the decade's profit; cheap or not CHEAP on FY2025 (12.3% earnings yield), FAIR on the trailing year (6.5%) and not cheap on the Q3 run-rate; floor PARTIAL: about two-fifths of the price in parent net financial assets at book (central case), a quarter to a half at the limits. Capital allocation: 64% of the decade's parent profit was declared as dividends, FY2024–25 payouts exceeded profit (114%, 110%); no raises or buybacks. Confidence medium: the business verdict rests on direct S2 series, but the valuation depends on an argued hurdle, an estimated ownership split, unverified rebate mechanics, and documents not in the local data.
what_would_change_our_mind: The 2026 Q3 report attributing the revenue deduction to a one-off price-protection or rebate true-up, with Q4 2026 cash collected back above revenue and receivables falling from 3.79亿, would turn the pass into a priced option on recovery (FY2025 parent operating earnings of at least 5.0亿 capitalise to about 50亿 at 10% against a stake priced near 26亿)

Evidence of lost end demand or share (a named competitor, a policy or label change, or a second quarter of collections near half the 2022–24 norm) would make the trailing 2.8亿 the ceiling and the price full

An annual-report subsidiaries note showing the parent owns well over half of 达因药业, or holds most of the group cash at parent level, would lift the floor from the ~17.9亿 central case toward its 21.7亿 limit; a lower stake or subsidiary-held cash would push it toward 10.8亿
A dividend cut to what operating cash supports would show that the owner is not harvesting at minority holders' expense
open_questions: What caused the 2026 Q3 revenue of 0.33亿 (below cost of sales 0.47亿) and the 0.26亿 Q3 asset impairment: a rebate or price-protection accrual, sales returns, or lost volume? Document: 2026 Q3 report notes and any exchange inquiry letter (问询函) with the company's reply.

What is in the 12.17亿 of other operating cash paid (FY2025), and is revenue recognised net of distributor rebates or market fees paid in cash? Document: FY2025 annual-report notes on 收到/支付的其他与经营活动有关的现金 and the revenue-recognition policy.

What is the parent's percentage ownership of 达因药业, and how much of the group's 21.7亿 of net financial assets sits at parent level? Document: FY2025 annual-report subsidiaries note and the parent-only balance sheet (母公司资产负债表).
Product concentration: what share of pharma revenue is one product (伊可新 vitamin AD drops is commonly cited, unverified locally)? Document: FY2025 annual-report MD&A product table.

Why did FY2025 cash collected (34.75亿) exceed FY2024 by 6.50亿 on revenue up only 0.94亿, with Q2 2025 alone at 10.86亿: a pull-forward by distributors? Document: FY2025 receivable and contract-liability notes and distributor-inventory disclosure, if any.

knowledge_candidates.text: FY2016–FY2025: operating income after tax (total firm) rose from 3.69亿 to 9.96亿 while net operating assets fell from 12.21亿 to 8.55亿; ten-year CFO − capex 66.07亿 against total net income 67.97亿 (parent 36.09亿). Operating liabilities rose 1.78亿 over the decade (49% of the NOA fall) and fell from 6.36亿 to 2.84亿 in 9M2026.

The consolidated gross margin rose from 60.85% (FY2020) to 85.11% (FY2025) through the exit of non-pharma segments (environmental equipment, education, materials, parks). The pharma segment's gross margin was 83.8% in FY2020 and 84.6% in FY2025, and its revenue rose from 11.24亿 to 22.15亿.
knowledge_candidates.source: S1 main_business 20201231, 20251231; S1 annual.销售毛利率

knowledge_candidates.text: Minority holders took 46.9% of FY2016–FY2025 total net income (31.88 of 67.97亿), and 4.93 of 10.29亿 in FY2025. Dividends paid to minorities were 5.04亿 in each of 2024, 2025 and 9M2026.
knowledge_candidates.source: S2 raw_income minority_income, net_income_total; S2 raw_cashflow dividends_paid_to_minority

knowledge_candidates.text: FY2020 → FY2025: (cash received from sales − 营业收入) rose 8.75亿 (3.71 → 12.46) while other operating cash paid rose 7.92亿 (4.25 → 12.17), and selling + admin + R&D expense rose only 1.63亿. VAT on the revenue increase explains about 0.53亿 of the gap's rise; the two series correlate across the decade.

Revenue is booked net of distributor rebates or market fees that are paid back in cash (gross invoices collected). The 2026 Q3 revenue of 0.33亿, below cost of sales, reflects a rebate or price-protection deduction rather than a pure volume fall. Precedent: Q3 2024 revenue 2.24亿 was followed by Q4 2024 7.57亿.
knowledge_candidates.source: derived from S2 raw_cashflow / raw_income FY2020–FY2025 and DuckDB 2026Q3; verifier: FY2025 annual-report other-operating-cash notes, 2026 Q3 report

knowledge_candidates.text: Distributors bought ahead in 2025 (Q2 2025 collections 10.86亿 against 6.60–6.98亿 in prior second quarters) and destocked in 2026 (Q2–Q3 2026 collections 3.44亿 and 2.61亿).
knowledge_candidates.source: S2 raw_cashflow single quarters (DuckDB, workpaper A5); verifier: distributor inventory or receivable ageing

knowledge_candidates.text: For a holding company with large minority interests and net cash, bound the parent's net financial assets before any reverse curve (minority claim wholly on cash; wholly on operations), state a central case from the minority profit share applied to the subsidiary's NOA, then value the cash at face and solve only the operating stake. Applying the operating hurdle to the full price (E = r × P) overstates the earnings the price needs.
